_comment: Corrections to scripts/i18n_glossary.py's results, checked by hand on the language wikis. They replace what the script finds. Say where each was checked.

Wallet.note: The English wiki's Wallet redirects to Currency, so its links name currency. Each of these is the wallet's own page on its wiki.

Wardrobe.note: The English page links to the German Account-Tresor (account vault). The German wiki's wardrobe pages are Garderobe/...

Guild Vault.note: Coffre de guilde: page on the French wiki. No German page found.

Junk (rarity).note: Item rarity: the rarity table on Gegenstand (de), Objet (fr), Objeto (es).

Basic (rarity).note: Item rarity: the rarity table on Gegenstand (de), Objet (fr), Objeto (es).

Fine (rarity).note: Item rarity: the rarity table on Gegenstand (de), Objet (fr), Objeto (es).

Masterwork (rarity).note: Item rarity: the rarity table on Gegenstand (de), Objet (fr), Objeto (es).

Rare (rarity).note: Item rarity: the rarity table on Gegenstand (de), Objet (fr), Objeto (es).

Exotic (rarity).note: Item rarity: the rarity table on Gegenstand (de), Objet (fr), Objeto (es).

Ascended (rarity).note: Item rarity: the rarity table on Gegenstand (de), Objet (fr), Objeto (es).

Legendary (rarity).note: Item rarity: the rarity table on Gegenstand (de), Objet (fr), Objeto (es).

Chat link.note: wiki-fr: the page Code en jeu, whose interlanguage link is the English chat link.

Build template.note: From the Build Template Expansion item (id 92209): wiki-de Build-Vorlagen-Erweiterung, linked to fr Extension de modèle d'archétype and es Expansión de plantillas de ajustes.

Oil Floes.note: Thunderhead Peaks meta. wiki-de Öl auf dem Eis, wiki-fr Les flaques d'huiles, wiki-es Los témpanos de petróleo (checked during the PR #214 translation review).

Ooze Pits.note: Grothmar Valley. wiki-fr La Fosse à limons; es from achievement 4934 (Participante en la Fosa de Légamos de Grothmar del día). German has no wiki-de name.

Aspenwood.note: Fort Aspenwood, Echovald Wilds meta. de: wiki-de event timer; fr: achievement Echovald Wilds Insight: Fort Aspenwood (« … : Fort Trembleforêt »).

Salvage kit.note: Every salvage kit item is « Nécessaire de recyclage … » in the French API (e.g. items 23038, 19986).

Stash.note: Guild stash: Gilden-Tresor in the German client. Lager is a WvW camp.

Treasury.note: Guild treasury: wiki-fr Trésor (guilde), NPC « Trésorier de guilde ».

Mastery.note: es client: Punto de dominio, Reflexión de dominios.

Downed.note: wiki-es Abatido, Lista de habilidades de abatido.

Speargun.note: wiki-es: Arpón is the old name of the underwater spear (now Lanza) and a crafting component.
